message.content:
I can see the vulnerability. In `loadProjection()`, the code writes to `p->args[i]` where `i` is incremented without any bounds checking. If there are more than `MS_MAXPROJARGS` (or whatever the size of `args` array is) string tokens in the PROJECTION block, it will write past the end of the `args` array, causing a heap-buffer-overflow.

Let me look at the `projectionObj` structure to understand the size of `args`:
